unspecified.behavior: The handler now calls `db.close()` on every addon route, including routes with no pre_check or with only an admin or addon_feature pre_check, where the session never checked out a connection.

scores.reason: Every addon proxy request runs this close. With no connection checked out it is a no-op, and the user sees no difference.

Every addon proxy request reaches db.close() at backend/app/routers/addon_proxy.py:613, but on routes that never queried, Session.close() on a session with no checked-out connection is a no-op, and get_db's second close at backend/app/database.py:708 is idempotent, so the user sees nothing.
